name: TH Analytica Agent
description: Agent card describing the capabilities and functions of the TH Analytica framework for AI visibility and readiness.

core_concepts.semantic_friction: Minimise ambiguous or conflicting terminology to help AI systems understand your domain.
core_concepts.agent_readiness: Design data, permissions and processes so AI-assisted systems can interpret possible actions and escalate them for human approval.
core_concepts.ai_actionability: Structure information so possible actions and their constraints are explicit without authorising autonomous execution.

actions.name: ai_readiness_assessment
actions.description: Evaluate the AI readiness of a given website or business process.

actions.name: ai_visibility_review
actions.description: Review and suggest improvements to the AI visibility of a website or digital asset.
